answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to participate in network consensus. This voyage into validator status enforces an economic barrier where an attacker must acquire significant assets, akin to forging ferrous links in a heavy chain, to manipulate the collective grove of nodes. Any attempt to spawn multiple fake identities fails because the cost of capital scales linearly, rendering disproportionate influence prohibitively expensive for adversaries.
